stories.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong Hits Three More, Reaches 47 Home Runs in Cubs 17-5 Blowout
stories.angle: Three more in a rout; the 40-40 conversation is now impossible to avoid.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
47 home runs. 37 stolen bases.

Three more homers last night in a 17-5 rout of the Reds.

PCA needs 3 steals to join the 40-40 club — only 6 players in MLB history. With 11 games left, it's happening. #Cubs

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
The 40-40 club all-time:

Canseco (1988). Bonds (1996). A-Rod (1998). Soriano (2006). Acuña (2023). Ohtani (2023).

Pete Crow-Armstrong is 3 stolen bases from being No. 7 — and the first Cub ever. #Cubs

article.headline: Pete Crow-Armstrong Hits Three More: 47 Home Runs, Three Steals from 40-40 History

stories.title: Misiorowski at 1,000 Pitches Over 100 MPH — The Most Dominant Cy Young Case in Years
stories.angle: The 1,000 pitches milestone puts this season in a tier by itself.

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
Jacob Misiorowski: first pitcher in Statcast tracking era history to throw 1,000 pitches at 100+ mph in a single season.

1.95 ERA. 236 K. 0.80 WHIP. The NL Cy Young isn't a race — it's a formality. #Brewers

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
The Brewers clinched their 4th straight NL Central title — the first team to do that since the division was created in 1994.

Misiorowski: 1.95 ERA, 236 K, -700 Cy Young favorite. Milwaukee is built for October. #Brewers

article.headline: Jacob Misiorowski Becomes First Pitcher in Statcast Era to Throw 1,000 Pitches at 100 MPH — And the NL Cy Young Is His
